title: XYZ Forge — Agent Engineering Operations System
sources: codebase-memory MCP graph indexed at a47c212b (structure, services, entry points)
README.md — capture → rate → plan → preflight → execute → gate → land → record
ROUTER.md + AGENTS.md — releases-mode authority, Python-default Tier-A routing, gate and worktree rails
src/flightdeck/ + web/flightdeck/ — passive loopback operational view

trust_boundaries.label: boundary: model-directed CLIs are untrusted executors
trust_boundaries.note: The shared guarantee is the harness allowlist, timeout, copy-back and scoped commit contract; a native CLI sandbox is defense in depth, not the authority.

trust_boundaries.label: boundary: worktree isolates files, not shared .git
trust_boundaries.note: Linked worktrees share config, refs, objects and hooks with the parent clone. Mutation-heavy suites run in a separate full clone.

trust_boundaries.label: boundary: STATUS alone is not approval
trust_boundaries.note: The relay supervisor accepts terminal approval only with a driver-authored attestation tied to the observed reviewer turn and revision.

trust_boundaries.label: boundary: runtime DB / mergeable SQL authority split
trust_boundaries.note: Business writes use releases_app verbs. releases.db is runtime truth and releases.sql is the reviewed Git merge surface; neither is hand-edited.

trust_boundaries.label: boundary: credentials and irreversible external effects
trust_boundaries.note: Provider requests, issue/PR writes and pushes cross the local-first boundary and require their documented gates.

trust_boundaries.label: boundary: local guard is not hosted attestation
trust_boundaries.note: Pre-push routing catches failures locally; promotion evidence comes from the exact-commit hosted macOS boundary. Ubuntu is advisory.

trust_boundaries.label: boundary: passive loopback consumer
trust_boundaries.note: Flightdeck reads bounded local projections and never refreshes or mutates their producers during a request.

nodes.label: Operator + skill router
nodes.description: Human authority enters through repo-owned skills and canonical startup rules. Skills select existing verbs and workflows; they do not create a second runtime state store.

nodes.label: HQ multi-repo command center
nodes.description: Resolves a project, inspects capability tiers, parks intake and prepares dispatch across repositories. The fire verb prepares work but never drives the harness.

nodes.label: PROJECT docs + CHANGELOG
nodes.description: Issue captures, active execution docs, completed records and the running change log. ROADMAP.md is a frozen legacy pointer, not live authority.

nodes.label: PDDA deterministic checks
nodes.description: Checks frontmatter, status tables, roadmap coverage, issue synchronization and changelog hygiene. Deterministic findings may gate; LLM review remains advisory.

nodes.label: Releases / roadmap CLI
nodes.description: Canonical verbs for release, manifest, roadmap, Jog and work-event state. Every business write goes through the lock, journal, receipt and dump protocol.

nodes.label: Releases ledger
nodes.description: SQLite is runtime truth; the generation-stamped SQL dump is the Git merge and rebuild surface. Includes roadmap_items, Jog rows, receipts and append-only work_events.

nodes.label: Planner + swarm preflight
nodes.description: Ranks ledger candidates, checks exact write sets, dependencies, readiness and freshness, then emits a machine-readable marathon invocation contract.

nodes.label: Jog serial supervisor
nodes.description: Leases and executes the immediate queue one item at a time. The default reviewed executor delegates each item to Marathon rather than maintaining a parallel build engine.

nodes.label: Marathon orchestrator + phase driver
nodes.description: Runs dependency-ordered phases, opens isolated lane clones, invokes relay review loops, gates phase advancement and emits durable results.

nodes.label: Relay supervisor (Python default)
nodes.description: Reads the tick actor and relay thread, invokes one actor per round, enforces progress/caps and writes reviewer-observed terminal attestation. Frozen .sh twin remains an opt-out fallback.

nodes.label: Poll / relay loop (Python default)
nodes.description: Decides runnable, idle, watchdog or stop from tick ownership plus terminal thread state; optionally dispatches the selected actor.

nodes.label: Marathon actor router
nodes.description: Maps the current agent id to its supported turn adapter. Builder routes and reviewer eligibility remain explicit rather than inferred from an executable name.

nodes.label: Turn adapters
nodes.description: Claude, Codex, agy, Aider, Pi, SmallCode, CommandCode and DeepSeek adapters build prompts, run one CLI and report typed outcomes. Muse is not represented as a live relay lane.

nodes.label: RelayTurnLib + relay-turn-lib.sh
nodes.description: Central enforcement shared by Python adapters and the Bash fallback: root resolution, worktree setup, bounded execution, off-lane refusal, allowlisted copy-back and one scoped commit; never pushes.

nodes.label: Agent CLIs
nodes.tech: claude · codex · agy · aider · pi · others
nodes.description: Model-directed subprocesses operating inside the selected workspace. They may edit and move the tick token, but harness containment and approval evidence remain outside them.

nodes.label: Model + search providers
nodes.tech: subscription CLIs · OpenRouter · grounded search · local LM Studio
nodes.description: Credentialed or local inference/search endpoints used by turn adapters, consult/research and ATE. Routes fail explicitly; no silent provider fallback.

nodes.label: GitHub issues, PRs, board + Actions
nodes.description: Issue-first signal stream, PR landing surface, optional Kanban projection and hosted verification/reconciliation triggers.

nodes.label: tick coordination kernel
nodes.description: Dependency-free local CLI for path-scoped claims, handoff, liveness, cost and completion. The RELAY-TURN task is authoritative for the current actor.

nodes.label: .tick events + state projection
nodes.description: Serialized local event log and deterministic current-state projection for claims and tasks. No server or per-event network path.

nodes.label: Relay thread
nodes.description: Human-readable producer/reviewer blocks and terminal STATUS. It carries review content, not authoritative actor ownership or approval by itself.

nodes.label: Relay approval attestation
nodes.description: Driver-authored evidence binding a witnessed reviewer verdict to the expected revision and range. Required for terminal authorization.

nodes.label: Runtime telemetry + provenance
nodes.description: Best-effort session/turn records, heartbeat and qualifying evidence. Telemetry aids diagnosis; it does not replace approval attestation or a committed gate receipt.

nodes.label: Local + hosted gate stack
nodes.description: Path-routed local guard, full local qualification and exact-commit hosted macOS promotion evidence. Ubuntu remains an advisory portability canary; mutation-heavy suites use a separate full clone.

nodes.label: Landing + hosted reconciliation
nodes.description: After a merge, updates issue/doc lifecycle, release/roadmap receipts and adopted projections, then publishes only declared artifacts back to development.

nodes.label: Flightdeck passive operations view
nodes.tech: loopback Python host + static web app
nodes.description: Passive/experimental local dashboard that aggregates typed bounded reads from configured XYZ ledgers, Rebalance, CLIO, Git Pulse and continuity sources. Requests never refresh producers.

legend_note: The graph follows the current lifecycle rather than enumerating every utility. Python is authoritative for Tier-A drivers and adapters; frozen Bash twins are compatibility fallbacks. Trust labels document authority boundaries, while type labels drive color. Flightdeck is a passive/experimental view, not an execution dependency.
